cases.sentence: В то время Авиа, ___ Иераваама, заболел.
cases.translation: At that time Abijah, the son of Jeroboam, became sick
cases.explain: The noun is the subject being discussed, so it takes nominative case.

cases.sentence: Возьми с собой десять хлебов, несколько лепешек, кувшин меда и иди к ___.
cases.translation: Take with you ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to the prophet
cases.explain: The preposition к (to, toward) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Ахия уже не видел, его глаза ослепли от ___.
cases.translation: Ahijah could not see; his eyes were dimmed because of age
cases.explain: The preposition от (from, because of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Я отнял царство у ___ Давида и отдал его тебе.
cases.translation: I took the kingdom away from the house of David and gave it to you
cases.explain: The preposition у (away from, from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Я буду жечь ___ Еровоама, как жгут навоз, пока он не сгорит дотла.
cases.translation: I will burn the house of Jeroboam like dung until it is all gone
cases.explain: The transitive verb жечь (to burn) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Тех, кто умрет у Еровоама в городе, сожрут ___.
cases.translation: Those who die from Jeroboam in the city will be eaten by dogs
cases.explain: The dogs are the subject of the verb сожрут (will eat), so they take nominative.

cases.sentence: На пятом году правления царя Раваама Шишак, царь Египта, напал на ___.
cases.translation: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam's reign, Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem
cases.explain: The transitive verb напал (attacked) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Раваам упокоился со своими предками и был похоронен с ними в городе ___.
cases.translation: Rehoboam slept with his fathers and was buried with them in David's city
cases.explain: The possessive construction uses the genitive case - 'города Давида' means 'city of David'.

reading.ru: Иераваам сказал жене, 'Пойди, переоденься, чтобы в тебе нельзя было узнать жену Иераваама.'
reading.question: Why did Jeroboam ask his wife to disguise herself before going to the prophet?
options: So the prophet would not know she was Jeroboam's wife
reading.correct: So the prophet would not know she was Jeroboam's wife
reading.explain: Jeroboam told her to disguise herself so she could not be recognized as his wife.

reading.ru: Жена Иеравама встала и пошла в Тирцу, как только она переступила порог дома, мальчик умер.
reading.question: What happened to Abijah as soon as his mother stepped through the threshold of the house?
options: The child called out to her
reading.explain: The text states 'как только она переступила порог дома, мальчик умер'.

reading.ru: Раваам, сын Соломона, стал царем в Иудее. Ему был сорок один год, когда он стал царем.
reading.question: How old was Rehoboam when he became king of Judah?
reading.explain: The text says 'Ему был сорок один год, когда он стал царем'.

reading.ru: Он правил семнадцать лет в Иерусалиме, городе, который Господь избрал из всех родов Израиля.
reading.question: Where did Rehoboam reign and what made that city special?
options: In Jerusalem, which God chose from all the tribes of Israel
In Samaria, the capital of Israel
In Bethel, where the golden calves were
reading.correct: In Jerusalem, which God chose from all the tribes of Israel
reading.explain: The text describes Jerusalem as 'городе, который Господь избрал'.

reading.ru: Иуда делала зло в глазах Господа. Своими грехами они возбудили его ревнивый гнев сильнее, чем их отцы.
reading.question: How did Judah's sins compare to those of their fathers?
options: They provoked God's jealous anger even more than their fathers had
They were less serious than their fathers' sins
They were the same as their fathers' sins
They did not anger God at all
reading.correct: They provoked God's jealous anger even more than their fathers had
reading.explain: The text says they provoked his anger more than their fathers.

reading.ru: На пятом году правления царя Раваама Шишак, царь Египта, напал на Иерусалим.
reading.question: When did Shishak, king of Egypt, attack Jerusalem?
options: In the fifth year of Rehoboam's reign
reading.correct: In the fifth year of Rehoboam's reign
reading.explain: The text specifies 'На пятом году правления царя Раваама'.
